ui_inference_rule.description: V4 profiles are included for an interval when interval.start >= profile.last AND interval.end <= profile.first; this is the original app predicate.
ui_inference_rule.limitation: This tests full containment of interval within an approximate occurrence range, NOT fossil-first appearance, taxon origin, or continuous occupancy.

migration_rule: Never promote age-filter matches to fossil observations or reviewed evolutionary ranges.
